Hydration is the rep nobody sees you take. Take it anyway.

5 rules every athlete should already know:

01 — Water is work. Dehydrated muscles fire 10–15% slower.
02 — Half your bodyweight. In ounces. Daily.
03 — Before. During. After. Drink at each.
04 — Water first. Electrolytes next.
05 — Thirst is late. Drink before symptoms.

Save this one for the next time training feels heavier than it should.

DM @dbelitefitness — first session on us.

#DifferentBreed #DBRules #HydrationMatters #NJFitness #TrainDifferent

posts.ig_caption:
The gravel we're hauling is the floor of the Coliseum, our new outdoor training space, and the people laying it are the same ones who show up to train here every week. Nobody hired a crew. Andrea grabbed a shovel, we broke up the ground by hand, and hauled it load by load until the base was set.

When it opens you'll find kettlebells, assault bikes, battle ropes, a cold plunge, and a custom sand pit out there, nothing like it around Teaneck.

We built this place together from the start, and the Coliseum is no different (every load of that gravel went in by hand), so we want you out there with us when the doors open. Coming soon.

#differentbreed #thecoliseum #teaneck #builtbyhand #njfitness

posts.ig_caption:
July challenge is live, and this one comes down to grip, legs, and how bad you want it. The Kettlebell Carry. You pick the bell up and walk it around the building, lap after lap, and the moment you set it down your attempt ends and we log your score. Men carry 65, women carry 40, and the only number that counts is how many full laps you get before it touches the ground.

We want the whole gym on the board this month, so grab a bell and go see how far you can carry it.

#differentbreed #kettlebellcarry #julychallenge #teaneck #njfitness

posts.ig_caption:
James Lyons had a heart attack in December of 2021. He says it was a bad one and it almost took him out.

One of the things he did to recover was start training boxing here at Different Breed, and it was rough at the beginning. He describes that first year as wading through cement.

Then he signed up for Blue Collar Boxing and fought in our ring. His opponent was half his age and outweighed him by 45 pounds, and James got the W.

He still takes medicine every day and he will for the rest of his life, and he says he feels recovered from the heart attack because of boxing.

Coach Pablo cornered him through all of it.

#becauseofboxing #bobstories #differentbreedboxing #boxingchangedme #teaneck

posts.ig_caption:
You can't throw a punch with poor balance.

Coach P sees the same thing over and over, too much weight on the front leg or sitting back on the rear one. Neither gives you a base to punch from.

His order is balance, then technique, then execute. Same order every time.

posts.ig_caption:
Anthony Johnson works over at Channel 7, and the stress that piles up in a week like that doesn't stay at the office. So he brings it here. Gloves on, and by the time he walks out it's off him.

He'll tell you boxing is good for you and it's healthy and it helps with the weight, and then he gets to the part that matters most to him. Mostly it's for the head.

Come in here, relieve that stress, go out and start to have a good day. His words, and that's about as good a reason to lace up as any of us have.

@abc7ny

#becauseofboxing #bobstories #differentbreedboxing #boxingchangedme #teaneck

You'll know after I'm done with you, he said, and then he answered the actual question. Because of boxing he feels more alive, he feels inspired, he feels young, and he feels different.

posts.ig_caption:
Don sent these over with one line about having young ladies in the camp, and what he actually filmed was the whole camp running a reaction board.

Lights go on the floor, you tap as many as you can, and somebody reads your score out loud while everybody else argues about who's in second. Two campers sat on 17. One got to 19 and took the top spot. Then she went, and tied the field at 17 on her first run.

Board resets every week, so nineteen is only safe until somebody decides it isn't.

Doug went first. Don is on tape saying it has begun, and by the end of the month there were ten names on that board.

Stephanie tied for first and told us exactly how hard it was. Kai took 16. Andrew Wexler put up 21. Owen climbed from 23 to 26, and Mike Goldklang finished on top with 27, which he had to argue for at the board because we still had him down at 26.

Two weeks left. Women 30 seconds, men 40, furthest distance wins.

#differentbreed #teaneck #ubechallenge #upperbody #itsjustwork

Coach Danny is @danielwilson78.

posts.ig_caption:
The August board is final. One sprint on the UBE, furthest distance wins, and two names sat on top when the clock ran out on the month.

posts.ig_caption:
Gil Moreno is 38 and he's been boxing since his early 20s. Ask him what it gave him and he starts with finding his wife and becoming a better man, and then he gets to Different Breed, where doing it himself turned into wanting to teach it. He's a boxing trainer now and he says it has kind of consumed his life.

"Because of boxing, I'm extremely, extremely fortunate to have met some beautiful people and I owe my life to it."

#becauseofboxing #bobstories #differentbreedboxing #boxingchangedme #teaneck

posts.ig_caption:
frank amaya had three kids at home and a full-time job when he signed up for blue collar in 2022. it was his first camp.

he told us the part that scared him most was his family coming to watch him get punched in the face, and then having to go home and tell his kids he lost. he trained the six weeks anyway and got in the ring that may, and he said the fear ended up being the thing that pushed him.

if that's what is holding you back, frank felt it too.

pre-camp is sunday, september 27 at 8am. come meet coach pablo and coach dred and see how the six weeks run. no experience needed, but you have to be registered to come, and the form is in the bio.

#differentbreed #bluecollarboxing #teaneck #njfitness #boxinggym

jr picked up boxing during the pandemic to get back in shape, and by may 2022 he was on his third blue collar camp.

he'll tell you the first camp lost about half its people by the halfway point, because hitting a bag for fitness is one thing and getting punched in the face is something else. what got him through all three was showing up every day and going to work, knowing the next man was working just as hard.

it starts with one morning. pre-camp is sunday, september 27 at 8am with coach pablo and coach dred. no experience needed, but you have to be registered to come, and the form is in the bio.

#differentbreed #bluecollarboxing #teaneck #njfitness #boxinggym

posts.ig_caption:
Friday morning on the Jacobs Ladder. He clips the belt on, somebody calls go, and the rungs keep coming for as long as he keeps climbing.

It works your whole body because your arms and legs climb together, there's no pounding on the floor, and it has no motor, so it only moves when you do. Coach Don sent this one over with three words, it's just work, and they're painted on our wall in Teaneck for mornings like this one (the front desk will get you started).

#differentbreed #itsjustwork #teaneck #njfitness #traindifferent
posts.fb_caption: Friday morning on the Jacobs Ladder at Different Breed. The machine only moves when you do. No gimmicks, just work.
